acceptance: The deps half of depRule and topoOrder is deleted with its tests; the triage prompt's grouping wording matches what remains.
priority_rationale: inbox review 2026-09-27: dead grouping logic with green tests misleads the next reader; no live failure
summary: Under ADR-0106 W3 a dependent never shares a lane menu with its unlanded dependency, so the classifier's dependency grouping is unreachable while its tests stay green over a path production no longer takes (second architecture review, design doc §7.7 W8). Links (connects_to) and campaigns stay.
title: Remove the batch classifier's dormant dependency half (depRule's deps loop, topoOrder's dependency ordering)
